body: The owner confirmed the three-games rule to this session directly. Units produced (documented = Kent 2001 or Midway Arcade Treasures; community = uncited database trivia): Defender 55,000+ (documented), Joust ~26,000 (community), Stargate ~26,000 (community, same uncited figure as Joust), Robotron ~19,000 (documented), Joust 2 ~1,000 (documented), Mystic Marathon 500 kits (documented), Turkey Shoot ~450, Splat! ~200, Inferno ~50 (community); Sinistar, Bubbles and Blaster unknown or conflicting. Open: Defender, Joust, Robotron, worked in that order. Our AGENTS.md steps 1 and 8 are being rewritten; docs/sync.md will note VectorCraft's step 7 wording for the next sync. Main e30d070.
summary: Loop change confirmed by the owner here; open games Defender, Joust, Robotron in that order
